name: Amagi Michiru
source:
Touya's younger sister. She's a sophomore in university. She has never been to Kansai, but she is a mysterious girl who speaks with the Kansai dialect. Youkai Exterminator top class possessor of spiritual power. Her Harisen seems to be always ready.
